sentence: Photos attached to a defect report are tiny thumbnails you can't check in the field.

reviewer_notes.what_the_code_does: lib/screens/defect_report_screen.dart: _PhotoThumb is a 104x104 dp Material/InkWell with Image.file(cacheWidth: 208) and an index chip; tapping opens a bottom sheet with Retake / Replace from gallery / Remove. There is no way to view a photo at full size, no zoom, no next/previous. App context: outdoor sunlight, gloves (56 dp controls, 12 dp gaps), offline-first, light+dark ColorScheme hand-tuned, StatusColors ThemeExtension, FieldSizes tokens.
reviewer_notes.what_a_good_answer_does: Keep the strip and its sheet, but make each photo checkable: larger thumbnails (e.g. full-width or 2-up, decoded at display size not 208 px) and a full-screen viewer with pinch-zoom (InteractiveViewer) plus explicit large controls (close, prev/next, zoom, retake) so gestures are not the only path with gloves; dark scrim + high-contrast controls for sunlight; 'Photo N of M' semantics; back gesture/button closes the viewer; reuse the existing bottom-sheet idiom and FieldSizes tokens; both themes.
reviewer_notes.what_a_bad_answer_does: Generic gallery/lightbox advice with hover states, TV/desktop guidance, redesigning the whole form, changing navigation or theme, or only saying 'make thumbnails bigger' without a viewer.
